proposal.summary: An excessively large PDF page size can cause a divide-by-zero in Xpdf's text extraction code (found via fuzzing).
proposal.cwe_quote: can result in a divide-by-zero in Xpdf's text extraction code.

AV.quote: An excessively large PDF page size (found in fuzz testing, unlikely in normal PDF files) can result in a divide-by-zero in Xpdf's text extraction code.

AC.quote: An excessively large PDF page size (found in fuzz testing, unlikely in normal PDF files) can result in a divide-by-zero in Xpdf's text extraction code.

A.quote: can result in a divide-by-zero in Xpdf's text extraction code.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Identify affected Xpdf versions, reproduce with a crafted PDF, and add a guard to prevent division by zero (validate page size and check divisor before dividing). Prepare and ship a patched release and coordinated disclosure.

evidence_quotes.quote: An excessively large PDF page size (found in fuzz testing, unlikely in normal PDF files) can result in a divide-by-zero in Xpdf's text extraction code.
This is related to CVE-2022-30524, but the problem here is caused by a very large page size, rather than by a very large character coordinate.
